deviations: attach_clients is passed ATTACH_TIMEOUT (180 s, x201's) rather than the profile's [client] timeout of 60 s: the raise happens only when the driver fires the event after both clients are ready, so the low timeout (which protects `pzt run` from a parked client) has nothing to guard during the attach.
